name: The Pariah's Instructions
label: Quest
description: The Pariah's Instructions: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... One not of any centaur tribe.
The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.
If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What did you decide, friend? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is it, traveler! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.
Take this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.
